description: an S-shaped wall of two tangent arcs of radius 2, one convex and one concave, with straight walls round them, extruded 4 along z, its top cut away above the plane z = 3 + (y − 2) tan a through (0, 2, 3), a box rotated a = 20° about x, and the top edge of the first arc filleted at r 0.3. The fillet runs on round the chain, the two ellipse arcs and the lines beyond them. At the arcs' tangent vertex (4, 2) the two walls are tangent along a vertical ruling, and the chain climbs at a, so the ruling leans out of the ball's normal plane: the two walked stripes meet on one ball off the vertex, on the ruling's offset (plans/three-edge-run-vertex). Open CASCADE's corner blends miss the rolling ball here as on blend/rounded-block-oblique-top-fillet: its volume is 3.1e-7 and its area 9.1e-7 off Arris's, below the 1e-6 a second oracle's record needs to differ, so the fixture is held to Open CASCADE at 1e-6 (centroid 1e-6 absolute), not the default (plans/walked-saddle-cell step 4)
